title: Iceickles's ultimate PvP pack
description: !!! STILL IN DEV. The only PVP texture pack you would need for the best PVP experience. changes the sword's texture to machete, small totem pop, low shield, low fire and a lot more.
body:
The only PVP texture pack you would need for becoming a master. It's capable of SMP, Crystal, UHC and a lot more types of styles. 

I knew I'll get famous even I don't use flashy description.

The pack includes low fire, low shield, changes the sword to a machete, changes the elytra to vex wings, small totem pop and a lot of quality of life changes that will make your pvp and SMP experience a lot more better.



![Weapon and etc.Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f3b7c14eab13bdf8c1b1b34a6c4ca777600badd6_0.webp)

This pack is also recommended using with glowing ores.
